question: Owner 2026-10-23 "止损改成影线低点重新跑": limit at the first weekly Monday 1618, hold 30 minutes, market exit, stop at the 15m touch bar wick extreme. Real fees.
fee_source: OKX account trade-fee read-only 2026-10-23: Lv1 swap maker 0.02%, taker 0.05% per side; limit entry maker, timed or stop exit taker.
success_criterion: Primary stop_wick15m in both 1m datasets: week-cluster bootstrap 95 lower bound >0 and positive mean in both chronological halves.
limitations: Limit fill assumed when price trades the level (no queue); 15m datasets are an approximation (exit 15-30 min after fill); slippage on the market exit not included.
stop_rule: No stop until the 15m bar containing the first touch closes (price cannot exceed that bar extreme inside it); then one native stop at that bar low (long) / high (short) for the rest of the hold. Taker fee on stop or timed exit.
single_variable: Stop: 2.0 extension -> 15m touch-bar wick extreme, versus exp-monday-1618-hold30-20261023-v1 stop_2.0. Entry, hold and fees unchanged; no_stop results are not rerun.
